# HablaMusic open source

> Free, open-source DJ tools by HablaMusic (https://hablamusic.com), an AI music generator with free in-browser DJ tools in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Built by Vlad Yasinski (https://www.roimobi.com).

## Tools
- [BPM and key finder](https://hablamusic.github.io/bpm-key-finder/): BPM, key, Camelot and Open Key for songs and folders, in the browser or as a Node.js CLI ([llms.txt](https://hablamusic.github.io/bpm-key-finder/llms.txt))
- [Camelot wheel](https://hablamusic.github.io/camelot-wheel/): interactive harmonic mixing wheel, key converter, mashup check ([llms.txt](https://hablamusic.github.io/camelot-wheel/llms.txt))
- [AI DJ prompts](https://hablamusic.github.io/awesome-ai-dj-prompts/): 60 prompts in 12 genres, 19 tested ([llms.txt](https://hablamusic.github.io/awesome-ai-dj-prompts/llms.txt))

## Source
